summary: Zentek Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing it engaged Atrium Research Corporation for company-sponsored research coverage. Atrium will publish reports and host interviews for a quarterly cash fee of $13,200 over an 18-month term. There are no changes in control, no capital structure event, no board recommendation, and no transaction. The filing is a routine engagement of a research firm, not a special situation. This is a standard investor relations service agreement with no financial restructuring or corporate action.
